description: Republic of Singapore Air Force collection at 400 Airport Road beside Paya Lebar Air Base. The museum closed for a refresh in September 2025 and reopened on 17 June 2026; the aircraft themselves were retained through the works. Ex-US Navy BuNo 145013, rebuilt to Singapore's A-4S standard. Photographed in the collection on 27 February 2024.

Mechanised Igla very short range air defence system displayed at the Air Force Museum after the June 2026 refresh - a Russian Igla launcher installed on an American-built armoured personnel carrier, described by visitor reporting as a local innovation. Recorded here as a displayed weapon system rather than an aircraft. No serial published.
